title: Kissed Smoky Ethiopian Lamb Dabo
description: A smoky and shattering Ethiopian dish featuring lamb shanks, perfect for a post-workout meal, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is made in a dabo form, bringing together the flavors of Africa and India
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb shanks and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the red bell pepper and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb shanks for 2 1/2 hours, or until they are tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb shanks in a dabo form, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by a side of injera bread.
